# Microsoft Power Apps documentation

Build low-code apps that modernize processes and solve tough business challenges.

## Sections

### Create and design
- Try/Buy Power Apps
- Create apps: Choose an app type, Plan designer, Canvas apps, Model-driven apps, Code apps
- AI copilot capabilities: Get started with AI copilot, Plan designer, Overview of the new experience (preview) (vibe/overview), Build apps through conversation, Add a Copilot control to a canvas app (preview)
- Create and manage data: Microsoft Dataverse, Tables and metadata, Business logic, Dataflows
- Use solutions: Solutions overview, ALM, Pipelines
- Integrate with other products: Power BI, Azure Synapse Link, Teams
- Best practices: Coding guidelines, Collaborate and co-develop apps

### Administer and extend
- Power Platform admin center, Licensing, Security and governance
- Dataverse developer guide (Work with data, Apply business logic, Create client applications)
- Model-driven apps developer guide (Client scripting, Code components)
- Canvas apps developer guide (Custom connectors, Offline-capable apps, Canvas components)

### Use
- Mobile devices (Power Apps mobile, Power Apps for Windows)
- Web browsers (Navigation, Search, Reports)
- Teams (Canvas as tab, Canvas as personal app, Model-driven as tab, Model-driven as personal app)
